blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.region` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a new region. It sends a request to the 
[Create Region](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#regions\_postregions)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the region to create.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the region.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the region.

children.name: countries
children.description: The 2 ISO code of the countries in the region.

children.name: automatic_taxes
children.description:
Whether taxes are automatically calculated during checkout
for this region.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description:
Whether prices in this region include taxes by default.

Learn more in the [tax-inclusive pricing](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/pricing/tax-inclusive-pricing#content) documentation.

children.name: payment_providers
children.description:
The IDs of the payment providers that are available in this region. The IDs are 
of the format `pp_{identifier}_{id}`.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the region.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the region.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: region
children.description: The region's details.

children.name: countries
children.description: The countries in the region.

children.name: id
children.description: The region's ID.

children.name: name
children.description: The region's name.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The region's currency code.

children.name: automatic_taxes
children.description: Whether taxes are calculated automatically in the region.

children.name: payment_providers
children.description: The payment providers enabled in the region.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the region was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the region was updated.
